text_block_list.text: I didn't win? Are you kidding me?!
choice_data_list: でも、いい走りだったぞ！
でも、いい走りだったよ！
choice_data_list_en: Still, that was a great run!
Still, that was a great run!
Let's aim for 1st place next time!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So what? It doesn't mean squat if I don't
place!
choice_data_list: でも、いい走りだったぞ！
でも、いい走りだったよ！
choice_data_list_en: Still, that was a great run!
Still, that was a great run!
Let's aim for 1st place next time!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: よかったところを伸ばせばきっと勝てる！
choice_data_list_en: If we build on your strengths, you can definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the whole reason I lost because I
don't have
any strengths?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No thanks. That sounds like torture. I'll
take the
recordings, though.
choice_data_list: ある！今日の映像を一緒に見ながら教えるよ
choice_data_list_en: There is! Let's watch today's footage together and I'll explain.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I suppose watching my past races for
reference
isn't such a bad idea.)

A few days later, I give Narita Taishin
the replays
along with some notes on her
running.

She seems annoyed by the notes, but
thankfully,
she takes everything, and we
get started on our
training session.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win and win and win...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And I'll rise high above the others so
that no
one'll ever talk bad about me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You're really getting too fired up about this.
choice_data_list: その意気だ！やってやろう！
その意気だよ！やってやろう！
choice_data_list_en: That's the spirit! Let's do this!
That's the spirit! Let's do this!

text_block_list.text:
The moment we get back, I look over
her training
schedule and talk to her
about the next race,
but...
choice_data_list: 君のトレーナーなんだから熱くもなるよ！
貴方のトレーナーなんだから熱くもなるよ！
choice_data_list_en: Of course I'd get fired up—I'm your Trainer!
I'm your Trainer, of course I get fired up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll win the next one, so calm down
already!

Despite being fed up with me, Narita
Taishin is
dead set on claiming victory.
